name: legacy-party-mapping-v33
sql:
CREATE TABLE rm_legacy_party_mapping_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 company_slug TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(company_slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
 legacy_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(legacy_kind IN ('customer','vendor')),
 legacy_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(legacy_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 party_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(party_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
 party_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(party_role IN ('customer','vendor')),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('mapped','superseded')),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
 prior_event_hash TEXT CHECK(prior_event_hash IS NULL OR (length(prior_event_hash)=64 AND prior_event_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash)=64 AND event_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 contact_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(contact_snapshot)),
 contact_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(contact_fingerprint)=64 AND contact_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json)),
 plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64 AND plan_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 idempotency_key_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key_hash)=64 AND idempotency_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 idempotency_payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_payload_hash)=64 AND idempotency_payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 reason TEXT,
 actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
 principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(principal) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(company_slug,legacy_kind,legacy_id,version),
 UNIQUE(company_slug,principal,event_type,idempotency_key_hash),
 CHECK((version=1 AND prior_event_hash IS NULL) OR (version>1 AND prior_event_hash IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK((event_type='mapped' AND reason IS NULL) OR (event_type='superseded' AND length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000))
);
CREATE VIEW current_legacy_party_mappings AS SELECT e.* FROM rm_legacy_party_mapping_events e JOIN (SELECT company_slug,legacy_kind,legacy_id,MAX(version) version FROM rm_legacy_party_mapping_events GROUP BY company_slug,legacy_kind,legacy_id) c ON c.company_slug=e.company_slug AND c.legacy_kind=e.legacy_kind AND c.legacy_id=e.legacy_id AND c.version=e.version WHERE e.event_type='mapped';
CREATE INDEX rm_legacy_party_mapping_events_lookup ON rm_legacy_party_mapping_events(company_slug,legacy_kind,legacy_id,version DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER rm_legacy_party_mapping_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_legacy_party_mapping_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'legacy party mapping events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_legacy_party_mapping_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_legacy_party_mapping_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'legacy party mapping events are append-only'); END;
